entry: Invoke /factory-build with your outcome, or choose /factory-blueprint, /factory-resume or /factory-status in the main Claude Code session. The underlying /factory-start workflow remains available.

sources.requirement: CLAUDE.md imports expand with @path syntax. Instruction text guides behavior and does not impose access control.
Subagent Markdown needs name and description. Specify task context explicitly. Tool allowlists and skills preloads are supported; new agent directories can require restarting the session.

Project skills live under .claude/skills and use SKILL.md frontmatter. Entry skills use argument-hint and user-invocable for slash commands; normal implicit discovery remains enabled. User commands can occupy the same slash name.
Permission settings govern tool execution; no bypass or broad permission grant should be generated.
Discover models for the actual account/client/harness. Validate constraints and record requested versus observed selection separately.

limits: Main session orchestrates; ordinary subagents receive explicit task context rather than the entire main conversation.
Planner and reviewer get reading/search tools without Bash; verifier execution can still mutate files and is checked by evidence fingerprints.
factory-models provides constrained model planning; requested selection is not proof of the model actually used. No global model settings are rewritten.

model_selection.inventory: actual host/picker inventory; user reports retain provenance
model_selection.application: host session picker or supported native subagent control; dispatch report does not apply settings
model_selection.effective_identity: runtime evidence when exposed; otherwise unknown
